g.text: M6 E5: real ESM1v proxy, fixed-cost high-value discovery
Development pools (256 per assay), 5 paired seeds, top 1% recall. HF cost = 100.
Costs are assumed acquisition units; uncertainty across assays is not estimated from seeds.
